# 2 Baruch Chapter 30 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**30:1** And it will come to pass after these things, when the time of the coming of the Anointed One is fulfilled, that he will return in glory.

**30:2** Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of him will rise again. And it will come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which the number of the souls of the righteous were preserved, and they will go forth, and the multitude of souls will be seen together at one time.

**30:3** And the first ones who have arrived will rejoice, and the last ones will not be sorrowful.

**30:4** For each one of them will know that the appointed time has come.

**30:5** But the souls of the wicked — when they see all these things they will waste away entirely. For they will know that their torment has come and that their perdition has arrived.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "fallen asleep in hope of him" (v.2) — all three agree on this phrase; "treasuries" (v.2) plural — consistent with the treasury-of-souls theology; "waste away entirely" (v.5) synthesizes LOGOS "waste away entirely" and EMET's simpler "waste-away"; "perdition" (v.5) over PNEUMA's "destruction" — perdition has appropriate eschatological weight.*
